newsitem.title: MEXICO: Ahmsa to save $2 mln/month with new plant.
newsitem.headline: Ahmsa to save $2 mln/month with new plant.

text.p: Steelmaker Altos Hornos de Mexico will save around $2 million a month in operating costs once a new carbon injection plant comes on line, the company said on Wednesday in a statement.
The new carbon injection process in the Alto Horno Five plant in Monclova, Coahuila, will eliminate the use of more costly natural gas and fuel oil, it said.
"According to the current prices of these hydrocarbons, their replacement with injected carbon will save around $2 million a month," the statement said.

The plant is due to start a test run this month, 14 months after building started. Ahmsa invested $20 million in building the plant. It is also considering carbon injection in two other plants, Alto Horno two and three, it said.
